notes.title: Version 1.0.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes: [list][*][p]Reduced the amount of Stamina drain when falling into the water[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where NPCs would become invisible, resulting in controls becoming unresponsive[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug when moving barn animals between the barn and the pasture, resulting in an occasional game crash[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug in pet training with extended delay between commands showing on screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug occurring while holding an item, then catching a bug/critter and reaching 0 Stamina, resulting in an occasional progress blocker[/p][/*][/list]
